incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Runtime regression detected in canary after rollout. Routing page to #eng-oncall and incident channel. Signal: spike in p95 latency and automatic kernel-fallbacks. Thread created 3417003000

alice_oncall: I'm on the page, grabbing the canary link and logs. Who kicked the rollout?

dave_release: I rolled the 2026.03.17-canary to 10% traffic ~5m ago. No errors in CI. Noticed a slight throughput drop in staging earlier but dismissed.

deploy-bot: Rollout metadata: service=inference-runtime, image=runtime:v2026.03.17, canary_pct=10, region=us-west-2, started=3417002970

ben_runtime: Observed kernel fallback on canary hosts. Host logs show repeated: `kernel_select: fallback_to_generic=1` and batching queue length climbing. p50->p95 delta ~200ms -> 900ms. Sample log: ```
[03-17T12:34:10Z] host-42 kernel_select: model=llm-v2 seq_len=2048 kernels=avx2 failed oom, fallback generic
[03-17T12:34:12Z] batching: queue_len=120 inflight=32 max_batch=64
```

carla_eng-sre: Looks like new kernel path miscompiled for this box type (avx2). We saw similar in canary earlier but scoped to night batch; maybe regression exposed at higher concurrency. Pinpointing hosts with `nodepool: canary-*-usw2`

alice_oncall: Good context. Quick mitigation: can we flip canary kill-switch to stop traffic to runtime:v2026.03.17? If rollback is low-risk, prefer immediate rollback.

dave_release: Initiating kill-switch now. `releasectl kill-switch --service inference-runtime --version v2026.03.17`

deploy-bot: Kill-switch acknowledged. Stopping new traffic to runtime:v2026.03.17. Rolling traffic back to runtime:v2026.03.16. Estimated convergence 2m.

support-jordan: Customer impact: monitoring shows ~120 requests/min across a dozen customers hitting increased tail latency. No errors returned yet, but several seats reported slow responses for chat flows (support ticket 2145 open). Notifying top-3 affected customers.

product-emma: Thanks — please include note to customers that we detected regression and rolled back; we should brief about root cause once confirmed. Prioritize any SLO alerting customers might get.

ben_runtime: After traffic shift begun, observed p95 trending down. Kernel fallback logs drop off on canary hosts. Batching queue length back to normal < 20 after 90s.

carla_eng-sre: We're collecting heap and kernel probe dumps from the affected canary hosts for postmortem. Tagging `regression:2026-03-17-canary` in logs.

alice_oncall: Handing off to ben/carla for root cause and postmortem. I'll keep incident open for 30m to validate stability and then close if green.

dave_release: Filed rollback record: roll-id=rbk-3417003000, reason="kernel fallback / batching regression", rollback_initiated=3417003070

support-jordan: Customer update sent to impacted list: "We've rolled back a canary deploy after detecting increased latency. We're investigating and will follow up within 4 hours."

ben_runtime: Confirming stability at +3m: p95 within normal band, no further fallback events. Will push diff of kernel compiler flags and a smaller canary to replicate safely in staging.

carla_eng-sre: Starting timeline capture and saving traces. Assigning action items: (1) reproduce locally with avx2 host (ben), (2) verify build flags and bump CI matrix (dave), (3) customer communication follow-up (jordan).

alice_oncall: Closing page in 30m unless any regression reappears. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> rollback applied, monitoring green. Incident remains open for investigation."
